verdict.rationale: The only agent-like evidence is an API endpoint that runs a 'published agent processor' on a document ([datalab-docs-40]) and AI-generated extraction schema suggestions ([datalab-docs-41]). These are API-invoked processors, not a documented interactive assistant inside the product UI (Forge). Missing for 10: an in-app conversational assistant users can delegate tasks to, documentation of how agents are created and what they can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
